role: ArchiveMigrations' deferred repairs: flag-gated index backfills (recovery score, endDate, meanHR/stress, sleep index fields, legacy Elite HRV stress/score), duplicate quarantine of same-night overnights, and re-linking of same-night split segments, plus the reupload notification name.
types: ArchiveMigrations: extension — migrations over SessionArchive state
ArchiveMigrations.RelinkWork: struct (private) — parent entry, file URL, ids to link
ArchiveMigrations.RelinkResult: struct (private) — new hash and link chain
toplevel: relinkEncoder and quarantineReadme static initialisers; Notification.Name.flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload = 'flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload'. The header says migrations are one-time, but runDeferredMigrations runs at every launch housekeeping and after every CloudKit pull.

units.does: Runs, in order: re-encryption of pending plaintext sessions, recovery-score/endDate/metrics/sleep-index/legacy-Elite index backfills, duplicate quarantine, and same-night relink. Each step takes/releases the archive lock itself.
Flag-gated backfill of sleepEnd + sleepSegmentCount on entries where both are nil, from each session's sleep snapshot/stored segments.

Flag-gated one-time pass over overnight and quick entries that carry a stress index or score: reads each session (which decodes with a legacy Elite import's made-up stress index and score dropped) and patches the entries of Elite imports whose index still holds them.

branches.cond: overnight/quick and stress index or score present

units.does: For an Elite HRV import whose entry's stress index or score differs from the decoded session's, the entry rebuilt with the session's stressIndex and recoveryScore (every other field from the entry, plus sleep mirrors); nil for every other session.

branches.cond: not an Elite import, or entry already matches the session

units.does: Generic 3-phase backfill: returns 0 if its done flag is set; snapshots entries needing work + file URLs under the lock; loads each session lightweight without the lock and builds patches; applies patches under lock (hash-guarded) and saves; sets the done flag only when every session loaded. Returns patch count.

branches.effect: loadedAll=false (flag stays off; retried next launch) and continue
append it; nil means nothing to patch
set flag true; else leave unset

units.does: Decodes a session file through the dual-format loader with the lightweight (no rrSeries) decoder; logs and returns nil on any error.

Under the lock, replaces each patched entry only if the current entry's fileHash still matches the patch's (drops patches for sessions re-archived since phase 1), then saves the index (failure logged only).

branches.cond: entry still present AND hash unchanged

branches.effect: log and continue (in-memory index patched, disk index stale)

units.does: Builds a copy of the entry with sleepEnd/sleepSegmentCount from deriveSleepIndexFields and sleep mirrors from the session; nil when neither field resolves.
Flag-gated backfill of recoveryScore = session.readinessScore for entries with nil recoveryScore and non-nil meanRMSSD.

Rebuilds an entry with recoveryScore = readiness, endDate/meanHR/stressIndex filled from the session where nil, and every other field — linkedSessionIds, sleepEnd and sleepSegmentCount included — from the entry, then overlays sleep mirrors.
Flag-gated backfill of endDate for entries with nil endDate from the session's endDate.
Rebuilds an entry with the given endDate, meanHR/stressIndex filled from the session where nil, every other field (sleepEnd and sleepSegmentCount included) from the entry, plus sleep mirrors.
Flag-gated backfill of meanHR + stressIndex for entries with nil meanHR and non-nil meanRMSSD; logs the count when >0.
Rebuilds an entry with meanHR and stressIndex from the session (overwriting), every other field (sleepEnd and sleepSegmentCount included) from the entry, plus sleep mirrors.

Unless merge mode is .off: picks same-night overnight duplicates (≥85% contained in a better-ranked keeper, nights older than 24 h, unlinked), moves their files to QuarantinedDuplicates/ outside the lock, then under the lock retires them from the index with tombstones (retireQuarantined); when either index save fails, the in-memory state is put back and the moved files are moved back (restoreFromQuarantine), so the stored index never names a moved file.

branches.cond: catch: retireQuarantined threw (an index save failed)
branches.effect: log warning, move the quarantined files back

units.does: Caller holds the lock: removes the ids from the index and tombstones them, saves deleted.json then index.json; on a save failure restores both in-memory sets and drops the caches, rewrites deleted.json without them (attempt) and rethrows. On success records a deletion time for each id.

branches.effect: roll back in-memory changes, rewrite tombstones, rethrow

units.does: Moves each quarantined file from QuarantinedDuplicates/ back to its archive path; a failed move is logged (attempt).
Under the lock, runs the pure duplicatesToQuarantine over overnight entries (linked ids protected, current schedule/now/merge mode) and maps the chosen ids to their file URLs.
Ensures QuarantinedDuplicates/ (+README) exists and moves each work file there, returning the ids whose move succeeded.

branches.cond: for each work item where moveToQuarantine succeeded

units.does: Moves one session file into the quarantine dir, replacing an existing file of the same name; false when the source is already gone (another run moved it) or the move throws.

branches.effect: log 'already moved by another run' and return false

units.does: Pure: set of every id that links others plus every id it links, among the given entries.

branches.effect: skip; else insert the entry id and its links

units.does: Pure: groups overnight entries by night anchor; for nights with >1 unlinked entry and no entry younger than dedupeSafetyWindow (24 h, hasRecentEntry — the rule relink uses), returns ids of losers ≥85% contained in the keeper.

branches.cond: for each night with more than one entry
hasRecentEntry (an unlinked entry younger than 24 h)

units.does: Pure: ranks a night's entries (has recoveryScore > has meanRMSSD > later start) and returns ids of the non-keepers whose ranges are mostly inside the keeper's; [] when the keeper has no endDate.

branches.cond: exactly one of the pair has a recoveryScore

branches.effect: that one ranks first; else later date first

units.does: Pure: true when the loser's span is ≥ duplicateContainmentRatio (0.85) overlapped by the keeper's, or (zero-length loser) its start lies inside the keeper; logs and returns false otherwise.

branches.effect: return true; else log overlap % and return false

units.does: Creates the quarantine directory if missing and writes README.txt (once) with UntilFirstUserAuthentication protection; failures logged.

branches.effect: log and return (moves will then fail individually)

units.does: Builds per-sleep relink work, rewrites each parent's file under the lock with missing links appended, and posts flowRecoveryArchiveSessionsNeedReupload with the changed ids.

Under the lock: groups overnight entries by night anchor, skips single-entry nights and nights with an entry younger than 24 h, splits each night into sleeps by the merge gap (0 when merge mode .off), and makes a work item per sleep with >1 recording.

branches.effect: gap = 0 (only touching/overlapping recordings form one sleep); else the user's merge gap

units.does: For one sleep's entries: latest-starting entry is the parent; others become ids to link. Nil for a single recording.
Pure: true when any entry started less than dedupeSafetyWindow (24 h) before now.

Under the lock: skips the work if the parent entry vanished or its hash changed since phase 1, or its file cannot be read for the rollback (priorFile); otherwise relinks (rewrites the file), replaces the entry with the new hash + links and saves the index. A failed save puts the previous file, entry and caches back (ArchiveStore.rollBackWrite) and returns nil, so the night is retried next launch instead of failing its hash check.

branches.cond: parent missing, hash changed, prior file unreadable, or relink returned nil

units.does: The parent's file before the rewrite (ArchiveStore.PriorFile: bytes, existence, pending-encryption state); nil, logged, when it cannot be read.
Loads the parent with the full decoder, appends work.otherIds not already linked, writes it back and returns the new hash + link chain; nil when nothing to add or load/write failed.
Decodes the parent file with the full sessionDecoder via the dual-format loader; logs and returns nil on error.

Encodes with relinkEncoder (encrypt if available), writes through writeArchiveBytes (protection by format; the ledger entry restored if the write throws), returns hash of bytes-as-written; logs and returns nil on error.
Static JSONEncoder with iso8601 dates and prettyPrinted+sortedKeys output used for relinked files.
Copies every field of the old entry, replacing fileHash and linkedSessionIds with the relink result.
